results.title: Commonwealth Seniors Health Card - Services Australia
results.description:
# Commonwealth Seniors Health Card
A concession card to get cheaper health care and some discounts if you’ve reached Age Pension age.

- be Age Pension age or older
- meet residence rules
- meet identity requirements

The Commonwealth Seniors Health Card has changed to a laminated card. If you get a new, renewal or replacement card sent to you, it may be either the new laminated card or the older style. The laminated card may seem brighter than the older style card.

If you need help to manage your Commonwealth Seniors Health Card, [call the Centrelink older Australians line](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/commonwealth-seniors-health-card#toolbar-phone).

[Who can get it\
\
You can get a Commonwealth Seniors Health Card if you meet certain conditions.](https://www.servicesaustralia.gov.au/who-can-get-commonwealth-seniors-health-card?context=21966)
